angle: It builds the network's fitted curve live from numbers, reshaping two identical softplus curves with explicit weights and biases on a single toy dosage example instead of teaching matrix notation or training.
angle_detail: Start with the worked forward pass at [08:25] and follow it through [12:30] to [15:25], since that numeric chain is the part no other source replicates. Note the course-clashing vocabulary: values on connections that multiply are weights and values that add are biases, stated plainly at [17:17]. Backpropagation is deliberately deferred at [04:21], so treat this as forward-pass intuition only and skip the closing promotion after [18:12].
